kind: record-only diagnosis (no verdict, no rule change)
label: M2 정식 판정 없음 — 근거는 AA 효과 크기 추정(보상 연합 d′ 6.02 [4.83, 7.49], 처벌 −4.52 [−5.89, −3.23], 넓힌 풀 16쌍, 커버리지 0.855 명목 미달)뿐. 탐색 단계(부록 AC).

opponent_channel.chance_note: 1/k^2 per pair (uniform independent pick on each side); a fixed opponent-blind pick switches 0

fly_odour_glom_jaccard_across_sides.note: FLY-TB: 1.0 by construction (odour of move type only)

point0_noise.note: point 0: FLY 0-11 + C-off 12-17 (FLY odours) and FLY-TB 18-23 (TB odours) each share w0 and the odours; only the decision seed differs -> the spread is simulation noise

opponent_channel.tb_design: FLY-TB odour = mean over the 16 POOL type sets of the E-grid odour of the move type, rescaled to the FLY mean total strength (flymon/ac/tb.py): the opponent-type channel is removed; the two sides of a pair present identical odours, so any TB pick change across sides comes from simulation noise

pairs.note: 'any' = at least one fly of the arm switched on that pair (FLY 12 flies, FLY-TB 6: unequal chance)

reinforcement.pulse_rule: agent/pulses.py: reward PAM08 400 ms x dealt_frac (+200 ms on a faint); punishment PPL105 200 ms resisted, 400 ms immune; super-effective has no separate term (only via damage)
